represents: About 3 hours of pod-sandbox starts across the 9 nodes of the same staging cluster as the node runtime sensor reports them: Deployment replicas from rollouts and restarts, DaemonSet node agents, StatefulSet replicas, Actions Runner Controller ephemeral CI runner pods, CronJob child Job pods named <cronjob>-<scheduled-minute>-<suffix>, Helm hook and manual Jobs, sandboxes recreated after a node reboot, and the kubeadm control-plane static pods (kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler) restarting with config.source file during a control-plane kubelet restart/upgrade.
provenance: synthetic; shapes from `crictl pods -o json` (CRI PodSandbox: id, metadata {name, uid, namespace, attempt}, state, createdAt as nanoseconds since the epoch, labels incl. io.kubernetes.pod.*, annotations incl. kubernetes.io/config.seen and config.source) as detections/k8s/cri-pod-sensor.sh records it; Job pod labels per the batch/v1 Job controller (batch.kubernetes.io/job-name, controller-uid, legacy job-name); static pods per kubeadm (component/tier labels, config.hash = pod uid, kubeadm advertise-address annotations); ARC runner labels per gha-runner-scale-set 0.9. Sandbox start times are drawn from the window, not ordered; names are fictional, addresses RFC1918.
adjacent_to: T1053.007/k8s_cri_job_pod.yml (every legitimate Job pod matches; CI runner pods do not)
T1543.005/k8s_cri_static_pod_start.yml (expected to fire on the kubeadm control-plane static pods)
